notes: JS111 = AP-L1898 capsules (in-licensed/co-developed by Junshi; China IND 2021). Phase I/II in NSCLC with EGFR mutations incl. exon20ins; new phase 2 NCT07518160 registered 2026.

latest_data: ESMO 2023 / Cell Rep Med 2024: phase 1a FIH (NCT05049265) in 28 pts across 5 dose levels up to 10 mg/kg; no DLTs, MTD not reached, no severe irAEs, preliminary activity in heavily pretreated pts; combination with toripalimab planned.
notes: Being tested with toripalimab in a pancreatic cancer immunotherapy platform trial (NCT06370754) and phase 2 in HCC (NCT06954467).

notes: Oncology phase 1 programs completed/terminated per CT.gov; AD program (NCT06094179) active-not-recruiting. Strategy shifted toward immunology (AD).

sponsor: Chia Tai Tianqing Pharmaceutical Group (Sino Biopharmaceutical)
indications: relapsed/refractory lymphoma (Hodgkin, T-cell, B-cell)|esophageal squamous cell carcinoma (combo)|myelofibrosis (combo with TQ05105)
